CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2818 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head f50079edb6659a67bab727b9beb68492d41ab191. Bus nonce: 84c613f869d588552a4c02d4ee043d63. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin f50079edb6659a67bab727b9beb68492d41ab191`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge f50079edb6659a67bab727b9beb68492d41ab191` or `Fix review: blocked f50079edb6659a67bab727b9beb68492d41ab191 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 84c613f869d588552a4c02d4ee043d63`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `f50079edb6659a67bab727b9beb68492d41ab191` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2818 f50079edb6659a67bab727b9beb68492d41ab191") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2818-84c613f8`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
ROUND 2 DELTA review of #2818 (triage batch 25, dev/programme/triage/s6-batch25.md, rulings P123 to P126). The new head f50079edb6659a67bab727b9beb68492d41ab191 re-rules P123 to R10-FLY-CARRY-DOC-CONTEXT.
Scope: judge ONLY the delta since 5e29f43f (`git diff 5e29f43f94309b03a97448b85cf444b3905d87fa f50079edb6659a67bab727b9beb68492d41ab191 --stat`), which is the P123 re-rule. Confirm P124 to P126 are unchanged.
Verify the file:line claims at origin/main: app_approve.sh carry() :203, :211, :243, :245, :266; delivery_row.sh :30-39; merge_train.py :54 and its calls; state_docs.py :13-14; app_push.sh :216-218; orchestrator.md section 11 :229-233. Say for each whether it is true at origin/main and whether the re-rule's reading of it is right.
Check R10-FLY-CARRY-DOC-CONTEXT is live on origin/main's roster (exists, not done, not absorbed). Check the Forward-carry `Carry: R10-ORCH-ROSTER-SCHEMA` landed on the roster at the roster SHA the orchestrator names in the dispatch line (2d45acb7a on handoff/audit-r10-roster); carry_audit must pass.
Check P123 Instances/Cost/Binding carry commands or references, the body's verdict figure matches the file, the PR changes only the batch file and its delivery row, and no host or home path appears.

No host or home paths in anything you push; cite repo-relative paths only.
